name: Security & Compliance Content Digest

parameters.content:
## Security & Compliance Content Digest

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers weekly to check configured security content sources via RSS feeds and pulls recent relevant items.
2. It drafts a plain-English digest summary of the content and assigns a unique ID.
3. The draft is logged in Google Sheets and an email is sent requesting review of the digest.
4. Separately, another weekly trigger checks for stale digest drafts pending review in the log.
5. If stale drafts are found, the workflow builds and sends reminder emails to reviewers.
6. It handles the case where no feeds are configured by drafting a setup-needed notice for visibility.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the SECURITY_DIGEST_FEED_URLS environment variable as a comma-separated list of RSS feed URLs.
- [ ] Set up Google Sheets credentials and create a sheet for logging digest drafts.
- [ ] Configure SMTP or email credentials for sending notification and reminder emails.
- [ ] Adjust lookback windows and stale draft age parameters in the workflow code nodes as needed.

### Customization

Customize the digest templates and email content in the respective code nodes to match organizational tone and information requirements.

## Trigger and feed preparation

This group includes the initial weekly schedule trigger, a conditional check for configured feed URLs, and building the feed URL list for processing.

## Feed fetching and filtering

Fetches each security feed and filters for relevant recent items based on publication date and keywords.

## Digest drafting and ID assignment

Drafts the plain-English digest summary and assigns a unique digest ID, including a fallback notice if no feeds are configured.

## Digest logging and review request

Logs the digest draft to Google Sheets and builds and sends the review request email.

## Stale digest check trigger and log read

Weekly trigger for checking stale digest drafts and reading the digest drafts log from Google Sheets.

## Stale drafts detection and notification

Identifies stale pending drafts and conditionally builds and sends reminder emails, or skips if none found.

nodes.name: Build Security Feed URL List
nodes.notes: SECURITY_DIGEST_FEED_URLS is the entire source list — a comma-separated list of RSS feed URLs (state AG breach notification pages, bar association publications, data-protection-law trackers).

nodes.name: Fetch Security Feeds
nodes.notes: Runs once per feed URL from the list above, fetching that feed's current items.

nodes.name: Filter Relevant Recent Feeds
nodes.notes: RELEVANCE_KEYWORDS and DIGEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS control what makes it into the digest — most weeks this should still find something across multiple feeds.

nodes.name: Draft Digest Content Blurbs
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch, not once per item — turns the filtered items into a single digest draft, explicitly noting when nothing relevant was found rather than sending an empty draft.

nodes.name: Assign Unique Digest IDs
nodes.notes: This ID ties the sheet row to this run — mostly useful if this template later grows a review/decision webhook like other ledger-based templates in this catalog.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;
return { json: { ...d, digest_id: 'DIGEST-' + Date.now(), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } };

nodes.name: Append Digest Drafts To Sheets
nodes.notes: Every weekly run gets a row here, even a 'nothing relevant this week' one — a visible record of the digest actually running. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: The actual review task — an email with the full draft, since this catalog has no established task-management integration to open a real task in.

nodes.name: Send Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification, not a client communication — no compliance guardrail wrap needed, same as PAC-76's internal review request.

nodes.name: When Thursday 9am Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Thursday 9am by default — a few days after the Monday digest, so a draft that's gone unreviewed gets one nudge before the next week's digest arrives on top of it.

nodes.name: Read Digest Drafts From Sheets
nodes.notes: Reads the full log — filtered down to stale pending drafts in the next step.

nodes.name: Flag Stale Pending Drafts
nodes.notes: STALE_DRAFT_REMINDER_DAYS controls the age threshold — defaults to 5 days.

nodes.name: If Stale Drafts Exist
nodes.notes: Only sends a reminder when there's actually something stale — no reminder email when the queue is clean.

nodes.name: Build Stale Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch of stale drafts, not once per draft — one reminder email listing all of them.

nodes.name: Send Stale Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification, not a client communication — no compliance guardrail wrap needed, same as the main review request email.

nodes.name: Skip When No Stale Drafts
nodes.notes: Nothing to nudge about this run — every draft has either been reviewed or is still fresh.

nodes.name: If Security Feed URLs Configured
nodes.notes: Checked here, while there's still guaranteed exactly one item from the trigger -- if SECURITY_DIGEST_FEED_URLS is unset or empty, the run used to silently die at zero items with nothing logged and nothing sent. Now it explicitly logs and emails a 'setup needed' notice instead.

nodes.name: Draft Setup Needed Notice
nodes.notes: Fires only when SECURITY_DIGEST_FEED_URLS is empty — keeps the log and review email showing up on schedule even before feeds are configured, instead of the run just disappearing.

description: Internal Protomated tool, Authority pillar, not deployed to clients. Runs weekly: pulls a configurable list of public RSS feeds (breach notifications, bar association security guidance, data-protection-law updates), filters to recent items matching relevance keywords, drafts a plain-English 'why this matters for small firms' blurb per item using a templated (not AI-generated) approach, logs the draft, and emails it to a content reviewer. Nothing publishes without a human review pass. Feeds Protomated's own newsletter/Field Notes content pipeline.
